name: Flagstar at Westbury Music Fair

evidence.note: Seating guide (ticket site) shows 360-degree seating in eight rows around a rotating stage.
Official site lists For The Love Of Freestyle on Sat Oct 3.
Preview of the Oct 3 freestyle show with Lisa Lisa, The Cover Girls and others; a dance-music bill.

dancing.notes: Every ticket is a reserved seat in rows around the stage, and there is no dance floor. Freestyle fans may stand and move at their seats, but plan on a seated concert.

description: A large theater-in-the-round with a rotating stage and up to about 2,800 seats, run by Live Nation. It hosts big-name concerts and comedy.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). westburymusicfair.org is a third-party ticket site, not the official venue site. That site calls the Oct 3 show 'Louder Than Love'; the official site calls it 'For The Love Of Freestyle'.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Run by Live Nation; the email is a Live Nation venue info address. The logo is white on a transparent background (needs a dark background). The best inside photo (round seating around the center stage) carries a small photographer credit in the corner ('Mark Schoen, 2013'), so we skipped it under the no-watermark rule; owner may decide to use it with credit: https://assets.livenationcdn.com/uploads/6c6b00a2-58ad-43e6-92b4-87ad310275e3.jpg (on /private-events). Seated theater; no dance floor. Existing description still fits; kept. westburymusicfair.org is a third-party ticket site (as already noted).
hours: Box office Wed-Sat 12 PM-5 PM; closed Sun-Tue (open on show days)
